label: CHANGE_1: ASeriesChanges x: x, an event, changes in its A-series determinations, from future to…
definition: `ASeriesChanges x`: x, an event, changes in its A-series determinations, from future to present to past. McTaggart argues that this is the only change there could be and that it is contradictory. It is not the case's motion (`MovedIn`, DEF-MOTION-AS-REDUCTION); DISAMB-CHANGE-A-SERIES says how the two are kept apart.
